set -euo pipefail

MODEL_PATH="/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-7B-DPO003-merged"
MODEL_NAME="democalib-dpo003-merged"
OUTPUT_BASE="/root/democalib/results/hgate_dpo003_merged"
NUM_RUNS=4

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base

if [[ ! -f "$MODEL_PATH/config.json" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Merged model not found at $MODEL_PATH"
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_BASE"

cleanup() {
    echo "Cleaning up vLLM servers..."
    kill ${VLLM_PID_2:-} ${VLLM_PID_3:-} 2>/dev/null || true
    wait ${VLLM_PID_2:-} ${VLLM_PID_3:-} 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT

echo "=========================================="
echo "  DPO-003 Merged Model H-Gate Eval"
echo "  Dual GPU: cuda:2 (port 8002) + cuda:3 (port 8003)"
echo "  Model: $MODEL_PATH"
echo "=========================================="

echo "[1/4] Starting vLLM on cuda:2, port 8002..."
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 TORCHDYNAMO_DISABLE=1 VLLM_USE_V1=0 \
    python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --model "$MODEL_PATH" \
    --port 8002 \
    --max-model-len 16384 \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --dtype auto \
    --enforce-eager \
    --served-model-name "$MODEL_NAME" \
    --enable-auto-tool-choice \
    --tool-call-parser hermes \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
    > "$OUTPUT_BASE/vllm_gpu2.log" 2>&1 &
VLLM_PID_2=$!
echo "  PID: $VLLM_PID_2"

echo "[2/4] Starting vLLM on cuda:3, port 8003..."
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 TORCHDYNAMO_DISABLE=1 VLLM_USE_V1=0 \
    python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --model "$MODEL_PATH" \
    --port 8003 \
    --max-model-len 16384 \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --dtype auto \
    --enforce-eager \
    --served-model-name "$MODEL_NAME" \
    --enable-auto-tool-choice \
    --tool-call-parser hermes \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
    > "$OUTPUT_BASE/vllm_gpu3.log" 2>&1 &
VLLM_PID_3=$!
echo "  PID: $VLLM_PID_3"
